Cargo.toml.note: Dependency set reduced to the non-Nostr subset; relay, HTTP, TLS and signing crates removed.

README.md.note: Rewritten without relay, keypair, channel and membership concepts.

TASKS.md.note: Task document contract retargeted from agentPubkey to a runner identifier; relay reporting removed.

TESTING.md.note: Upstream integration guide is relay-centric; replaced by the fixture-peer and real-runner qualification split.

src/acp.rs.note: Decomposed into twelve bounded modules; permission auto-approval replaced by a caller-supplied decision defaulting to cancellation; terminal-auth and vendor notification capability advertisements removed; relay-derived prompt assembly dropped.

src/acp/system_prompt_tests.rs.note: Covers relay-derived system prompt assembly that this port does not carry.

src/base_prompt.md.note: Standing instructions rewritten without Buzz CLI, relay and channel references.

src/config.rs.note: Launch, runner, model, permission and prompt sections ported; key, persona, relay and membership sections dropped.

src/engram_fetch.rs.note: Nostr memory fetch keyed by relay identity.

src/filter.rs.note: Nostr author gate, owner resolution and workflow provenance checking.

src/git.rs.note: Nostr commit and tag signing, scoped credential helpers and ephemeral keyfile custody.

src/git_runtime_tests.rs.note: Tests the Nostr Git signing runtime that is not ported.

src/isolated_execution.rs.note: Isolated turn execution retained; relay socket publication removed.

src/lib.rs.note: Composition root only; relay connection, subscription and channel discovery wiring dropped.

src/main.rs.note: Thin binary entry point delegating to the library run function.

src/pool.rs.note: Session and turn machinery ported; channel context resolution and relay presence dropped.

src/pool/pi_prompt_tests.rs.note: Pi harness prompt specifics outside the default runner catalog.

src/pool_lifecycle.rs.note: Pool lifecycle states retained without relay-driven wake conditions.

src/prompt_framing.rs.note: Modern and legacy first-turn framing retained; relay context injection removed.

src/prompt_project.rs.note: Channel history projection depends on relay reads; deferred with the persistent transport.

src/queue.rs.note: Inbound batching, deduplication and overflow replay arrive with the persistent transport.

src/relay.rs.note: Nostr WebSocket intake, NIP-42 authentication, NIP-98 signing and REST channel discovery.

src/relay/recovery.rs.note: Relay reconnection and subscription replay recovery.

src/relay/recovery_tests.rs.note: Tests relay recovery that is not ported.

src/relay/recovery_wake_tests.rs.note: Tests relay recovery wake conditions that are not ported.

src/run_task.rs.note: One-shot task invocation, terminal record and exit codes ported; identity check retargeted to the runner identifier.

src/runtime.rs.note: Shared runtime, pool startup and prompt context retained; relay client, owner and key fields removed.

src/scope.rs.note: Channel, thread and task scopes generalized to one opaque caller-named session scope.

src/session_model_channel.md.note: Channel session model is a relay concept.

src/session_model_task.md.note: Task session description retained without relay reporting instructions.

src/session_model_thread.md.note: Thread session model is a relay concept.

src/setup_mode.rs.note: Relay onboarding, membership registration and interactive setup.

src/usage.rs.note: Relay publication of usage and cost telemetry.

tests/fixtures/task_agent.py.note: Deterministic ACP peer retained with all ten failure modes; launch-log assertions retargeted from relay URL, agent key and Nostr git keyfile to the harness-reserved variables this repository injects.

tests/pool_lifecycle_state.rs.note: Arrives with the standing pool in the persistent transport slice.

tests/run_task.rs.note: Binary-level task contract tests ported; relay, identity and memory cases removed.

tests/stdio_contract.rs.note: Clean-stdout contract ported; the unreachable-relay startup failure is replaced by an unresolvable runner.
